model.name: featureManager.viewGrantedUser
model.description: R31.8c — tapping a granted-user child in the FeatureManager tree opens that user's FULL MASKED profile (RbProfileDetail). Server-resolved by opaque id: FeatureManager.grantedUserProfile(featureUuid, userId, profiles) matches userId (sha256[:16]) against the feature's allowedUsers token-hashes -> userProfiles.get(token) -> returns a MASKED FULL PROFILE {name, avatar, identifiers:[maskIdentifier...], grantedFeatureCount?, deviceCount?} — NO token, NO secretCode, NO raw PII (INV-F7). Backs the thin owner-gated GET /api/feature-manager/granted-user endpoint that RbProfileDetail.mount fetches. Singular-chain. Architect design 4e713fb6b / design-r31.8c-fm-detail-refine.md.
